scenes.vo: Think working in AI means writing code?
scenes.headline: WRITING CODE?
scenes.newInformation: The film opens on an assumption about working at an AI company.
scenes.visualMetaphor: An oversized code window crowds a small presenter; explicitly conceptual, not product UI.

scenes.headline: LOOK AGAIN.
scenes.newInformation: Invite the viewer to reconsider the assumption.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The code window is pushed out of frame as the robot leans toward the next reveal.
scenes.transition: Hard cut to actual legal-role proof.

scenes.headline: LEGAL.
scenes.newInformation: An IP counsel role and its employer appear in the same captured card.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Huge LEGAL type replaces the code motif; two verified source crops show title and employer.
scenes.transition: A short warm introduction follows the surprising role.

scenes.headline:
Meet
Solomon.
scenes.newInformation: Solomon is the product used to explore the company’s jobs.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A clean presenter entrance and a single brand title.
scenes.transition: Turn from brand introduction to the actual company search.

scenes.vo: Start with a company you're curious about.
scenes.headline: START WITH A COMPANY.
scenes.newInformation: The recorded Solomon search is set to anthropic.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The actual search input becomes the main object, with the presenter pointing to it.
scenes.transition: Cut wider to the resulting application view.

scenes.vo: Then look at what it's actually hiring for.
scenes.headline: LOOK AT THE WORK.
scenes.newInformation: Establish the real company-filtered Jobs interface, without treating the whole page as proof of individual facts.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A full application view provides context before a readable detail shot.
scenes.transition: Cut into a specific job family.

scenes.headline: LEGAL WORK.
scenes.newInformation: The title names trademarks and domains; its category says Legal and Compliance.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Three linked original crops from the same card make the legal function unmistakable.
scenes.transition: A presenter reset prevents the proof sequence becoming a list.

scenes.vo: And that's not the whole picture.
scenes.headline: THERE’S MORE.
scenes.newInformation: The first role is not the entire story.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The robot looks to the empty side of frame as a second illustrated branch unfolds.
scenes.transition: The new branch becomes real partnerships evidence.

scenes.headline: Partnerships.
scenes.newInformation: The recorded title names Economic Mobility Partnerships Manager.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Another full-screen role reveal, backed by the visible title stem and original employer.
scenes.transition: Cut back to a presenter who connects the two roles.

scenes.vo: A different role. At the same company.
scenes.headline: SAME COMPANY.
scenes.newInformation: Both roles carry the same employer in the same source capture.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The original employer is foregrounded rather than inventing a new logo or a hiring statistic.
scenes.transition: Expand two specific examples into a qualitative role map.

scenes.vo: The company builds AI. The work reaches beyond engineering.
scenes.headline: BEYOND ENGINEERING.
scenes.newInformation: The examples show different kinds of work inside an AI company.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A labelled conceptual map connects AI COMPANY to LEGAL and PARTNERSHIPS. It is not a headcount chart.
scenes.transition: Return to the viewer and the qualifications caveat.

scenes.vo: Each role has its own requirements. Read them. Match your experience.
scenes.headline: READ THE REQUIREMENTS.
scenes.newInformation: These examples do not remove the need for relevant qualifications or imply coding is never required.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Two oversized conceptual checklist cards say REQUIREMENTS and YOUR EXPERIENCE, without fabricated job requirements.
scenes.transition: Carry the experience card into a new frame.

scenes.vo: You don't have to search every field.
scenes.headline: NOT EVERY FIELD.
scenes.newInformation: Focus the exploration instead of indiscriminately browsing every category.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A fan of conceptual field cards collapses into a single YOUR FIELD card, with no numerical hiring claims.
scenes.transition: The selected card returns to the presenter.

scenes.vo: Start with the work you know, then find where it exists.
scenes.headline: START WITH YOUR WORK.
scenes.newInformation: Use known expertise as the starting question for the search.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The YOUR FIELD card becomes a doorway; the presenter invites attention toward it.

captionPhrases.text: Start with the work you know,

scenes.headline:
More than
engineers.
scenes.newInformation: Resolve the opening misconception using the legal and partnerships examples.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The opening code brackets open outward, leaving room for LEGAL and PARTNERSHIPS alongside the character.

scenes.headline: Solomon.
scenes.newInformation: Close with Solomon’s name, without an unverified public link or posting promise.
scenes.visualMetaphor: One wordmark, a calm expression and a short hold.
